name: Bistro Celeiro
address: Diep River Seven Passes Road, Wilderness, 6538, South Africa
description_short: Portuguese-inspired bistro tucked away on Seven Passes Road serving hearty home-style meals in the Wilderness forests.
description_long:
Bistro Celeiro sits quietly along the scenic Seven Passes Road, offering a genuine Portuguese dining experience in the heart of Wilderness. The warm, unpretentious atmosphere makes it feel like you've stepped into someone's home kitchen, where traditional recipes are honoured and portions are generous.

The menu leans heavily on Portuguese classics — think flame-grilled chicken peri-peri, espetadas, and rich seafood stews that speak to the coastal roots of the cuisine. Their wood-fired oven turns out proper pizzas too, giving families and groups plenty of options. The setting, surrounded by indigenous forest with glimpses of the Diep River, adds to the escape-from-it-all feeling that Wilderness does so well.

It's the kind of spot where locals bring visitors to show them something different from the beachfront crowd. Service is friendly and unhurried, matching the relaxed rhythm of the area. Whether you're breaking up a scenic drive or looking for a midweek dinner that doesn't require dressing up, Bistro Celeiro delivers honest food in a setting that feels authentically Garden Route.
